description: BIND this agent session to the USER'S OPEN /sim — the session-bootstrap contract (tk_2ba54e8466bc19 / tk_7069d33b0c682e). Call this FIRST, before creating or editing anything: pass the page URL the user has open…

actor_label.description: Optional display name for your presence row (e.g. "Claude — FL county modeling"). Defaults to your key's agent label.

clear.description: true = unbind this session (removes the binding + the warning/refusal behavior). Ignores the other params.

page_url.description: The /sim URL the user has open (…?sim=sim_xxx…) — the sim id is parsed from it. Prefer this: it is the ground truth of what they are looking at.

strict.description: true = mutations targeting any OTHER sim (and orphan create_simulation calls) are REFUSED while this binding stands (error bound_session_mismatch). Default false = soft binding_warning only.

workspace_scope.description: Optional workspace for THIS call: use an exact personal/team ID from list_workspaces. Repeat on each call; it does not change the connection default. Must agree with MCP metadata and the effective HTTP workspace selector (header, otherwise connector URL). OAuth connections can only use their granted workspace. Membership and campaign permissions still apply.

name: bind_session
